# Gengchou v2.4.1

v2.4.1 is a focused maintenance release that makes tray notifications easier
to interpret and records the current cost of adding another quota provider.

## Changes

- Reserve the Windows warning glyph for notifications that require action,
  currently rejected provider credentials. Routine provider detection, quota
  reset, and Claude Code update notifications use the Gengchou app icon and
  remain silent, so the warning glyph keeps its meaning.
- Add `docs/ADDING_A_PROVIDER.md`, a dated engineering note covering the
  current provider integration surface and the OpenCode Go usage research.
  External details in that note are explicitly snapshots and must be
  re-verified before being used for implementation.

## Updating

No settings or cache migration is required. Users of v2.4.0 can update
normally or replace the existing executable with `gengchou.exe` and start it
again.

Do not update an installation older than v2.2.4 directly to this release. The
v2.2.4 release remains available as the required bridge.
